chart.name: Serchable document growth rate (%)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('SearchableDocuments', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ES')).mean().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('SearchableDocuments', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ES')).timeshift('1h').mean().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('SearchableDocuments', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ES')).timeshift('1d').mean().publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('SearchableDocuments', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ES')).timeshift('1w').mean().publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = ((A-B)*100/B).publish(label='E')
F = ((A-C)*100/C).publish(label='F')
G = ((A-D)*100/D).publish(label='G')
